question: Steeplechase is a hurdle race with water jumps came into existence in England around ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1710**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Steeplechase** is a type of obstacle race that involves hurdles and water jumps, primarily part of track and field events today.
 
• The origins of the steeplechase can be traced back to **1710 in England**, where it began as a cross-country race between church steeples, hence the name "steeplechase."
 
• Participants in the original steeplechase races had to traverse various natural obstacles such as stone walls, ditches, and streams, replicating the challenges of countryside terrain.
 
• The modern steeplechase format in athletics was later introduced and standardized, with the race usually covering **3000 meters** and featuring fixed barriers and a water jump.
 
• It became a part of the **Olympic Games** in the **1900 Paris Olympics**, further solidifying its status as a competitive track and field event.
